evidence.quote:
in supersession of earlier delegations made vide letter no. HRD/2(1)2013/Delegation of
Powers/2092 dated 02 May, 2016

relationships.scope: Supersession is limited to permission for private foreign visits; the May 2016 original remains missing.

The 2026 circular concerns vigilance clearance for foreign-visit permission of Group C cadres under the 2025 Staff Regulations; it cites the October 2017 delegation and does not state that it replaces it.

limitations: This concerns permission for EPFO staff to visit foreign countries on private visits and who may grant it; it is not about EPF members, international workers or social security agreements.

The 2013 circular says only the CPFC had been delegated the power and that permission was being granted at lower levels; the 2014 order delegates Group C permission to ACC (HQ)-HR. The 2016 circular (and the 2017 delegation that supersedes it) set the prior-permission requirement and the authorities. The 2026 circular concerns vigilance clearance under the 2025 Staff Regulations; whether it changes who grants permission is not stated.
Eligibility, conditions and the DoPT rules cited in these circulars are not restated here; check the circular and the DoPT OM for conditions.
No commencement dates are stated beyond issue dates; dates are the issue dates of the circulars.

PDFs for entries marked compiled_copy were read from a compilation of circulars (Delegation_Circulars_Combined.pdf); its hash identifies the compilation, not a public original, and the app does not offer a download for them. Scanned pages are OCR.
